resources.string: On-device text-to-speech with Gradium Phonon 31M (English). Speech never leaves the phone.

1. Download the voice model (a one-time download of a few tens of megabytes; Wi-Fi recommended). The internet is used only for downloads.
2. Optionally, download all voices from Gradium's voice catalog, and pick the one you like.
3. Open the system text-to-speech settings and choose this app as the preferred engine.

To use another Phonon checkpoint, put its config.json, tokenizer.json, model.q8.gguf (or model.safetensors) and voices/ in a folder on the phone and import it. Downloaded voices are kept.
Hello! This is Phonon, speaking on your phone, without the internet.
Tap a voice to hear it and make it the default; ▶ only plays it. Apps that are already open switch to a new default the next time they set their language, or when restarted.
